excerpt.zh: 在太空中我们发现了一个严重损毁的双足机器人。我们尚不清楚它的能源，但我们可以从它的记忆体中获取一些信息。
excerpt.en: We have found a heavily damaged bipedal robot floating in space. We do not understand its energy source, but we may be able to retrieve information from its memory.

texts.zh: 在太空中我们发现了一个严重损毁的双足机器人。我们尚不清楚它的能源，但我们可以从它的记忆体中获取一些信息。
texts.en: We have found a heavily damaged bipedal robot floating in space. We do not understand its energy source, but we may be able to retrieve information from its memory.

sections.zh: 在太空中我们发现了一个严重损毁的双足机器人。我们尚不清楚它的能源，但我们可以从它的记忆体中获取一些信息。
sections.en: We have found a heavily damaged bipedal robot floating in space. We do not understand its energy source, but we may be able to retrieve information from its memory.

texts.zh: 在太空中我们发现了一个严重损毁的双足机器人。它的面部毫无特征，而它的金属外构严重损坏了。初步的扫描显示它还有残留的能源，不过它使用的能源和我们的大相径庭。也许它的内部电路还能留存一些过去的数据，不过充能和翻译数据需要花费一些时间。
texts.en: We have found a bipedal robot floating in space. Its faceplate is featureless, and its metal exterior is damaged. Preliminary scans indicate it has residual power, but its power source is radically different from our own. Its internal circuitry may hold memories of its previous existence, but recharging it and translating its information will take time.

tooltips.zh: 让我们看看你的记忆，宇宙旅行者。
tooltips.en: Let's see what you remember, cosmic traveler.

texts.zh: 通过不懈的努力，我们找到了充能机器人并扫描它记忆体的方法。难过的是，这个机器已经严重劣化，我们难以取回有条理的信息。我们会考虑发起后续研究，可能会研究它的其他同类，但这个机械流浪者的命运永远会是一个谜。
texts.en: Through diligent effort, we have found a way to recharge the robot's power supply and scan its memory banks. Sadly, the machine has deteriorated so badly that we cannot retrieve coherent information. We will consider a follow-up study, and we may search for others of its kind, but the fate of this mechanical castaway must remain a mystery.
